decisions.reason: As an organic line extension with only limited website prominence, this platter looks more vulnerable than the other launches but still worth keeping for another year unless sell-through clearly disappoints.
Its own product page and positioning as an organic poultry snack suggest active support and a good fit with convenience snacking, so we would keep it on the market.
The dedicated page and premium sharing format indicate a deliberate innovation with reasonable market potential, so we would continue it while monitoring performance.
